mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY increases > 2% without subsequent tightening by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM without subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters without subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO declines > 2% MoM without subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in real personal savings (RSAFS) signals a shift in consumer spending from savings to investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of HOUST increase and RSAFS decrease does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS < 1% without subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increases > 200,000 without subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or GDPC1 increases for 2 consecutive quarters without subsequent positive returns.
